title: Rust fragmentation tombstones omit terminal replay state and cached response
description: FragmentationPolicy terminal tombstones store only one rule/deadline per direction. They omit session high-water counter, terminal outcome, and cached final ACK/abort; repeated newer terminal traffic cannot receive idempotent response, post-hold-down allocation does not require counter above prior session, and alternating rule IDs overwrite live tombstones. Persist bounded per-rule terminal state/outcome/response/high-water and enforce replay-safe hold-down/reuse with shared vectors.
